scenes.voiceover: Mars just made oxygen. Here are the three numbers that matter.

content.title: MOXIE Made Oxygen on Mars
content.subtitle: NASA's Perseverance rover, Jezero Crater, Aug 2023

scenes.voiceover: Sixteen runs, one hundred twenty-two grams total, and ninety-eight percent pure.

content.title: The Numbers
items: 122g total — about a small dog's 10-hour breath

scenes.voiceover: So humanity has now brewed air on another planet. That's the takeaway.

content.title: We made air on another planet.
content.subtitle: First resource extracted off-world for human use.
